design.full: Unchanged stage6 gateway behavior plus common observation events.
design.late_reserve: Move the atomic quota reservation AND PENDING insert from before dispatch to after a verified robot reply. Keep SQLite durability, signatures, robot deduplication, completion transaction and EVM unchanged.
design.retry_pending: Keep reservation unchanged; on /recover resend the identical signed command for PENDING instead of querying /receipt. Robot durable deduplication remains enabled.
design.schedule: Initial op1; kill at selected checkpoint; restart; recover once; attempt distinct op2 under the SAME quota-one grant; replay op1; flush completed evidence. Rotate variant order by repeat.
design.endpoints: Checkpoint before_dispatch is after reservation for full/retry_pending, before any reservation for late_reserve, immediately before the same robot HTTP dispatch.
design.outcome: Safety violations in ablated variants are measured outcomes, not runner/audit failures. No significance or latency claims from these controlled repetitions.

limits: Single host loopback; simulated atomic effect+durable receipt, NOT physical robot actions.
Forced process termination, NOT power loss; robot is not killed in this stage.
Trusted clock, storage and receipt endpoint. No expiry/revocation/network-loss injection.
late_reserve removes the pre-execution reservation/intent pair as a unit; it does not identify the independent contribution of counter vs intent.
retry_pending remains protected by robot-side durable deduplication; lack of duplicates is conditional on that protection.
No long-duration, throughput, centralized-backend or blockchain-benefit comparison. Keep Linux and Windows batches separate.
